limitations: Visual evidence labels describe declared source state and do not certify clinical or regulatory validity.
Comparison mode is intentionally capped at two charts to protect desktop responsiveness.
Plotly selection-to-row mapping depends on the visual's displayed data order; aggregated marks link to displayed aggregate rows.
Static chart images inside PDF/DOCX/PPTX require an optional image renderer; the bundle always includes interactive HTML, figure JSON and data.
A complete all-page browser screenshot sweep was not claimed because the build runner exceeded its time window.
